I found the current root only has a placeholder `compile.sh`, so the deliverable is not runnable yet.

To reach equivalence for the benchmark area, I’m narrowing implementation to the stable `nu -c` expression/pipeline surface and using the reference CLI plus representative Rust tests as the contract; a likely wrong direction would be trying to port all of Nushell instead of matching the evaluated command families.

[package]
name = "nu"
version = "0.1.1"
authors = ["The Nushell Project Developers"]
description = "a new type of shell"
license = "ISC"
edition = "2018"

# See more keys and their definitions at https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/manifest.html

[dependencies]
rustyline = "4.1.0"
sysinfo = "0.8.4"
chrono = { version = "0.4.23", features = ["serde"] }
chrono-tz = "0.6.3"
derive-new = "0.5.6"
prettytable-rs = "0.8.0"
itertools = "0.8.0"
ansi_term = "0.11.0"
conch-parser = "0.1.1"
nom = "5.0.0-beta1"
dunce = "1.0.0"
indexmap = { version = "1.0.2", features = ["serde-1"] }
chrono-humanize = "0.2.1"
byte-unit = "2.1.0"
ordered-float = "1.0.2"
prettyprint = "0.6.0"
cursive = { version = "0.12.0", features = ["pancurses-backend"], default-features = false }
futures-preview = { version = "0.3.0-alpha.16", features = ["compat", "io-compat"] }
futures-sink-preview = "0.3.0-alpha.16"
tokio-fs = "0.1.6"
futures_codec = "0.2.2"
term = "0.5.2"
bytes = "0.4.12"
log = "0.4.6"
pretty_env_logger = "0.3.0"
lalrpop-util = "0.17.0"
regex = "1.1.6"
serde = "1.0.91"
serde_json = "1.0"
serde_derive = "1.0.91"
getset = "0.0.7"
logos = "0.10.0-rc2"
logos-derive = "0.10.0-rc2"
language-reporting = "0.3.0"
directories = "2.0.2"
toml = "0.5.1"
toml-query = "0.9.0"

[dependencies.pancurses]
version = "0.16"
features = ["win32a"]

[dev-dependencies]
pretty_assertions = "0.6.1"
